However much power that 'god' had, there had to be some limit to the area it could warp. Otherwise, how had we escaped the last attack?

Distance, then. Still the safest answer.
As fast as possible—as FAR as possible!

en.html:
With a defense that unreasonable, even the electromagnetic draw would not guarantee victory. And we did not have the heat for a trial run. No firing one off just to see how God liked it.

The nodachi's electromagnetic draw would probably be a one-time affair. Getting a second chance would be difficult. I could think of no other attack that would wound that thing fatally.

Meaning...
Assume it could defend by warping space. Work out how to stop it doing that. THEN use our decisive attack.

Very sound conclusion.

Only the doing of it remained...

ja.html:
そんな天地法外な防御措置を取られては、電磁抜刀
といえど必勝を期し難い。
　そして、<ruby>試し撃ち<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>をやれるような熱量はない。

　野太刀の電磁抜刀を使えるのはおそらく一度きり。
　二度目の機会を得るのは難しいだろう。そして他に、
あの〝神〟に致命傷を与える攻撃方法というのも考え
つかない。

　つまり……
　空間歪曲による防御を想定し、その無効化の算段を
つけた上で、決戦力の行使に臨むべし。

　結論としてはそうなる。

　そうなるが……
